blocks.text: MANILA — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) drove away a Chinese fishing vessel and four small boats on Thursday for allegedly engaging in illegal fishing in the territorial waters of Lawak Island in Kalayaan, Palawan. In a statement, PCG Spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Rear Admiral Jay Tarriela said the operation was carried out by PCG personnel stationed on the island. “Lawak Island is an integral part of the Municipality of Kalayaan, Province of Palawan. Under international law, the Philippines exercises full sovereignty over its territorial sea, where no foreign vessel may fish without authorization,” Tarriela said. READ: PCG deploys […]...
